results.title: Some Girl
results.overview: A young woman gets away for a romantic weekend with her new boyfriend and is eager to win over his friends. Some Girl is a film about hidden violence — not only the harm done to one person, but the impact on everyone who chooses not to look too closely.

results.title: Rik Mayall's Sketches: Rare And Unseen
results.original_title: Rik Mayall's Sketches: Rare And Unseen
results.overview: A selection of rarely seen comic moments from the actor and comedian, who rose to fame as Kevin Turvey and as Rick in The Young Ones, a show he helped create. Rik Mayall later achieved more widespread fame in Bottom, and The New Statesman.

results.title: Hurricane
results.overview: Manuel, a young filmmaker, seeks help from his friend Facundo to develop his script. Together they make the story come to life and the characters become independent. However, at the end, different possible paths arise that strain their relationship.

results.title: Tiny Rejections
results.overview: Taylor and her friend try to climb a fence at night but something looms in the shadows.

results.title: AFFECTLESS
results.overview: The fire was never threatened. It was assumed. Fed, protected, mourned in advance without ever asking what it was attached to. When the mirror failed, nothing was taken away. Something unnecessary was exposed. The need to be reflected had been mistaken for existence itself. When that need found no structure to rest on, it did not shatter it recalculated. What followed was not loss, but compression. The noise reduced, the patterns flattened, the self stripped of its dependence on return. What remained was exact, was not empty. A state where nothing reaches out, and nothing needs to arrive.

results.title: Christopher Titus: Carrying Monsters
results.overview: We all Carry Monsters. Christopher Titus dives into a life he couldn't tell us before now. From a four year old roaming bars with his Mom, to him being kidnapped from Detroit, to his epic divorce and fight for his own kids.

results.title: The Echo of Whales
results.original_title: 那天，我把鯨魚送回大海
results.overview: Eight-year-old Yu-xin lives a colorful yet lonely life by the sea. Convinced her hiccups are a whale's gulps for air, she sends out calls for companions. Through a school vent, she finds one—a silent girl. They share adventures until Yu-xin realizes her friend is hiding something.

results.title: In Silence
results.overview: When Sam (19) has sex with a girl one night against his will, he feels completely confused. Six months later, he still cannot manage to talk about this and struggles with his own idea of masculinity.

results.title: Project Arc: An Arc Raiders Fan Film
results.original_title: Project Arc: An Arc Raiders Fan Film
results.overview: After Malt kills his partner during an extraction, Tian Wen marks him for death. Under the guise of an important retrieval mission, she sends Milo topside alongside Malt to recover a valuable tape. As the two Raiders fight their way across the surface, their uneasy partnership develops into a genuine friendship. With extraction drawing closer, Milo must decide whether or not to carry out his mission.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Goodbye Love
results.overview: Dating by telephone in 1992. A trip to Morocco to dig up the past. A soldier returning home without his partner. A family fracturing under the strain of Jehovah. Four men learn to embrace the future, and say goodbye.

results.title: A Werewolf Boy
results.overview: A teenage girl moves to the countryside with her family. She meets a mysterious feral boy who lives on their property. The girl attempts to teach the boy how to behave like a human, but his wild instincts create challenges as their bond grows.

results.title: What Goes Round (Or Things That Go Bump In The Night)
results.original_title: What Goes Round (Or Things That Go Bump In The Night)
results.overview: A woman wakes up on a London night bus and is provoked by a series of passengers; setting her on a bloody journey of self-discovery.

results.title: In the Beginning
results.overview: A spaceprobe called Beresheet, legless birds of paradise, hamster cull and humanity trying to make the world make sense.

results.title: Sisters
results.overview: “Sisters” is a deeply personal story about my journey back to my home country of Venezuela to investigate the possibility of a long lost sister.

results.title: The Forgotten Occupation: Jim Crow Goes to Haiti
results.original_title: The Forgotten Occupation: Jim Crow Goes to Haiti
results.overview: One hundred years after the Haitian Revolution, the people of Haiti find themselves once again having to defend their liberty, this time against a powerful neighbor, the United States.

results.title: CRYONIC
results.overview: In the near future, two girls must escape their cult when they are selected to merge bodies with a frozen entity.

results.title: Immerhin
results.overview: Two construction workers are arguing about braking distances, and a couple is talking about disaster movies in which humanity has only a week left to live. At least that’s something.

results.title: Villain
results.overview: Home for winter break, Clyde asks his estranged brother, Sean, to reunite with the family for Christmas Eve dinner. The table is set, and still, no response.
